name: com.indieable.sdk
description: Privacy-aware Unity client for Indieable sessions, game-scoped identity, account linking, gameplay telemetry, playtest feedback, bug reports, and Community Challenges.

samples.description: Initialize Indieable locally, read the privacy manifest, establish a session, choose optional telemetry, submit feedback, and query Community Challenges.
Runtime UI Toolkit dashboard with balanced optional-permission prompts, Preview configuration, gameplay telemetry, playtest forms, account linking, and Community Challenge controls.
